citations.claim: The component has seven external runtime dependencies: anthropic, httpx, parallel-web, pydantic, python-dotenv, rich, and typer
WebSearchClient acts as the main facade class orchestrating web search operations with credential detection and backend routing
ParallelBackend manages interactions with both REST API and MCP protocol based on API key availability
ClaudeSynthesisPipeline implements a three-stage synthesis process: reviewer, writer, and citation validation
The search method supports both free MCP and paid REST backends with automatic fallback and synthesis options
Deep research functionality requires PARALLEL_API_KEY and supports processor selection from the pro/ultra families
The backend implements automatic fallback from REST to MCP when authentication fails
Credential detection uses both tool context and secret() to support server and CLI environments
Deep research validates processor selection to pro/ultra families and sets processor-appropriate timeouts
The synthesis pipeline returns both report content and validation errors, preserving writer output even when citation repair fails
Citation validation implements a repair loop with up to 2 attempts to fix invalid source IDs
Response models use Pydantic with backward compatibility fields like exa_request_ids as aliases
CLI interface provides search command with filtering options and pretty-printing modes
Deep research CLI command supports processor selection and includes backward compatibility warnings
System prompts define structured templates for evidence review, report writing, and citation repair with specific JSON schemas
